name: EFTP
welcome: Welcome to **EFTP**, an FTP program for the Atari ST, STE, TT and Falcon. It copies files and whole folders between your Atari and a server, both ways, resumes a transfer that stopped, keeps the files' dates, and reaches secure servers too: FTPS and SFTP.

window.title: The window
items: Your Atari: its drives and folders.
The server: drag files either way, or use Upload and Download.
Transfers: what is going and what went, and how fast.

diagram.title: How EFTP reaches your servers
diagram.round: [[Falcon mode|Secure servers: FTPS and SFTP]]: a Falcon or TT does FTPS itself
after: Plain FTP needs neither. For FTPS a Raspberry Pi on your network can do the encryption for any Atari, or a Falcon or TT can do it itself (EFTP.PRG); SFTP always goes through the Pi. See [[Secure servers: FTPS and SFTP]].
